dataset.name: GenImage
dataset.legacy_baidu_distribution: Documented by official repository; extraction code ztf1
dataset.license_boundary: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus project Dataset Terms; non-commercial academic/research use

generator_scope.policy: Acquire all eight official GenImage generator subsets when feasible; do not silently substitute mirrors.
generator_scope.partial_acquisition_rule: If any official subset cannot be acquired, stop before scientific split freeze and record exact missing subset(s); do not redefine the experiment silently.

split_policy.validation_and_test_derivation: Do not derive final validation/test until exact native-val inventory and duplicate/family audit are frozen.
split_policy.prohibition: No sample from native val may enter training; no AEGIS v1 official-test sample may be accessed.
split_policy.generator_generalization_design: Must be decided prospectively after acquisition inventory; both pooled and held-out-generator questions remain possible but neither is authorized yet.

integrity_protocol.hash: SHA256 per acquired file plus canonical manifest SHA256
integrity_protocol.decode_check: Read-only image decode/metadata verification after acquisition; no resave or recompression.
integrity_protocol.duplicate_exact: Group identical SHA256 values across generators, splits, and labels.
integrity_protocol.near_duplicate: Freeze a perceptual near-duplicate method and threshold only after inspecting acquired image formats/resolutions; do not invent threshold in Step2B.
integrity_protocol.cross_label_collision: Any exact duplicate appearing under both AUTHENTIC and MANIPULATED is a mandatory quarantine/review condition.
integrity_protocol.corrupt_file: Exclude from scientific pools and record reason; never silently delete from provenance ledger.

storage.manifest_git_policy: Commit only compact provenance/manifests that do not redistribute dataset image bytes and are compatible with dataset terms.
storage.capacity_rule: Measure available local disk space before acquisition. Do not begin full acquisition if planned files cannot be stored with a safety margin.

acquisition_execution_rules.resume_partial_downloads: Allowed only if the acquisition mechanism preserves file identity and final hashes are verified.
acquisition_execution_rules.archive_handling: Hash downloaded archives/files before destructive cleanup; preserve acquisition log.
acquisition_execution_rules.network_failure: Stop cleanly and retain verified completed artifacts; never mark incomplete acquisition complete.
acquisition_execution_rules.terms_failure: Stop if current official terms cannot be accepted for the intended academic research use.

known_bias_control_requirement.reason: Published follow-up work has reported image-size/compression shortcuts in raw GenImage. T1 must audit format, dimensions, and compression-related metadata before architecture/training authorization.
known_bias_control_requirement.effect: No claim of semantic/generative-forensic discrimination may be made without documenting shortcut-risk controls.
